response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count * 1.0) OVER () AS difference FROM order_counts), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) AS place FROM differences) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id;
